summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload math_init.js
details: @servicetitan/marketing-global-route 1.14.4 declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/...zip`, extracts it to a temp directory, and invokes the freshly-fetched Bun binary via `execFileSync` against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB heavily obfuscated blob carrying a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header, a shuffled string-array decoder (`WV8StW`/`hc1jfK9` rotation, 1000+-entry mixed constant array), and hex-mangled identifiers, with no corresponding source in `src/`. The package advertises itself as a URL/route helper — a library that has no legitimate need to install a second JavaScript runtime or execute a 700KB obfuscated sibling at install time. The package.json also has an empty `author` field and no `repository`, while CHANGELOG links point at `github.com/servicetitan/standalone-fe`, inconsistent with a legitimate corporate release under the `@servicetitan` scope. The alternate-runtime-dropper pattern (payload executed under a freshly-fetched non-Node runtime) bypasses Node-based inspection and gives the publisher arbitrary code execution on every installer's machine at `npm install` time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
